note: verification of revision 7 own edits; all three blockers were introduced by that revision

blocking.issue: The C2 trigger did not propagate into step 4.1, which still counted n on C1 - the exact counter pass 6 removed from Decision 21. Separately, the flag counted valid days while G2 requires days containing an observation of the cell, so n could concentrate in 9 of 12 days and fire the flag with the G2 condition unmet.

The two halves of the byte budget are not jointly satisfiable on the plan own arithmetic: 4.32M messages x 15-40 level records at 8 bytes is 520 MB to 1.4 GB per symbol-day against a 150 MB cap in the same decision.

The gross 10.5 bps threshold survived inside H6, one paragraph above the sentence declaring it deleted; SETTLED recorded the deletion as performed. Gross drops slippage, which the plan itself puts at 1-5 bps against a 3 bps margin, so a sample with net -2 bps would read green.

human.question: Which cell carries the verdict when both C1 and C2 pass G2
human.resolved_as: 6.3 runs both; C2 is the verdict cell when it passes, C1 otherwise; fixed before the data and added to the pre-registration list

human.question: Is the 2000 dollar depth floor per level or across the top 50
human.resolved_as: per level - median notional per level within the top 50

human.question: What detects a mid-recording change of tickSize or qtyStep
human.resolved_as: both a hot-path modulus check and an hourly instruments-info re-poll on the existing probe timer
